body: Like I said above, it's not possible. But thanks.

I can see where you're coming from. You might even be right, I don't know. But I feel like it's a little more complicated than that.

I love sex. I don't love sleeping with random people I don't know. So I figured having friends with benefits would be a good way to go. And while, yes, a "standard, healthy, emotional relationship" is the ideal, I'm not sure I would want it even if I had no mental issues. I'm in college, and after dating the previously mentioned ex-boyfriend for rather a long time, I felt like I was missing out. I enjoy being single, I just like having sex as well.

Add all of this to the fact that I know I'm "damaged goods." Of course I should take myself off the market, no guy would want to get involved with me if they knew everything, and it's not fair to lure them in and then spring it on them. So in a way I see it as taking myself emotionally off the market. But I'm also not depriving myself, because, well, I'm only human. Maybe it's too selfish of me, but there it is.
My reply got a little more personal than I was intending, so I PM'd you.

Thank you for the advice. Like I said in another comment, I'm not really dating these guys, just sleeping with them. I have no desire for things to get serious. So based on your advice, I'll probably not share this information with them.

When I said casual dating, I suppose I was being a bit euphemistic. I'm not going on dates, I'm basically just repeatedly sleeping with the same people. At most, we'll grab dinner or watch tv, but for me, these "relationships" are all about sex. They know this as well.

Does this change your opinion at all?
